title: Greeley C NDE 20215
content:
I was in the washroom having problems breathing. All of a sudden, I was looking at myself. I could see the whole washroom but it was like I was near the upper far left corner looking down towards the toilet. The washroom was not big, but it was all in view. I looked at my body on the toilet. It looked like I was slumped over and leaning to my left. All of a sudden, I realized I was not in myself and that did not seem to bother me. I was not feeling anything but peace. Then I realized I did not even feel my breathing. It was at that moment when I saw I was not breathing that a panicky feeling overcame me. It was as if I was sucked back very fast into myself, as if the second I panicked that I was back and gasping for air. I have never had an experience like this since but I would like to do it again. It scared me at first but now, later in life, I know there is nothing to be afraid of. Death is nothing to be scared of now. I have tried to project myself since and read up on it but to no use. It was a once in a lifetime experience that changed my life. I know for sure there is something more when we die. We leave our bodies. I now believe in a similar manner but that is just my opinion. I myself know, think and believe with all my heart now that there is more.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes Allergic reaction Clinical death I went into anaphylaxis shock from dog dander and ceased to breath.
elements.At what time during the experience were: During the experience I could see all going on around me and everything happening.
elements.Did you pass into or through a tunnel?: Yes I knew I was in my washroom.
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: A clearly mystical or unearthly realm I did not feel like I normally would and I had no smell that I can remember. But I could feel I was not breathing.
elements.What emotions did you feel during the ex: I was fine at first and really did not have any feelings other than feeling very at peace, even while watching myself until I saw I was not breathing then I felt panicked.
elements.What is your religion now?: Conservative/fundamentalist Full belief in God and the Catholic Church Now this experience directed me to God through time and study for now I know there is life after death
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: Yes My belief in the afterlife, from that day on I was a true believer and no longer afraid of death also I am now a true believer in God and the Holy Catholic Church.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: The feeling I first had, but the worst part was the panic I felt when I realized I was not breathing.
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes My mother she did not believe me, a priest he believed me, and my wife also believed me. My wife was a attempted murder victim from before I meet her and she has had a near death experience of a tunnel and a choice of whether to go or stay, so she believe me as well.
